name: TOORAD
summary: A tabletop dark-matter proposal using axion quasiparticles in magnetic topological insulators as the conversion medium.
detection_principle: An external field tunes the quasiparticle mass in the material; resonance with the cosmic axion field produces an electromagnetic signal for photon detectors.

key_parameters.name: Nature of proposal
key_parameters.value: Resonant conversion through material quasiparticles; no verified parameters of a completed detector

results.summary: A concrete experimental concept has been proposed; axion quasiparticles in a material do not constitute discovery of cosmic dark-matter axions.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
